noInherit.description: If true, the annotation is not inherited by mixins.

ui.description:
The name of the UI that this extension is applicable to.
UIs are namespaced in the `/ui` directory of a package and webpack extensions are
matched to UIs by setting this field value to the same name as its subdirectory
in `/ui`.

title:
Associates a type with a webpack UI.

Example:

If you have a package with a webpack configuration in: mypackage/ui/myUi/config/webpack.config.js,
you can associate a type to it in the following way:

      @webpack(ui="myUi")
      type MyWebpackType
name: Ann.Webpack
